description: Follow a marketplace listing (by id), a seller (by seller.id) or a site on the AI Terms list (by host), and hear when a followed listing's price or payment terms change or it goes down or comes back up, or a site's AI Terms change. action: "follow", "unfollow", or "changes" (what changed since a day, plus what you follow). Changes come from AIPayGen's daily checks; your phone app gets one notice a day when something changed. Free; needs your API key.

host.description: A site on the AI Terms list (/ai-terms/adopters), e.g. example.com

listing.description: Listing id as kind:id, e.g. api:x402-14342d806afbda09

seller.description: A seller.id from search results (16 hex)

since.description: changes: from this day, YYYY-MM-DD (default 7 days ago, at most 30)

name: follow
title: Follow listings, sellers and sites
